messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered PD-4872 — Rate limiter anomaly for service `quota-service`. Symptoms: sudden global 429 spike, limiter heartbeat missing, quota assignments showing zeros. Triggered at 2026-03-14T12:34:38Z. Links: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4872 | Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/limiter/overview

pagerduty-bot: Primary on-call: @sam, you have the page. Escalation policy: 5m -> ops-sre if unacked.

sam: acked — on it. looking at limiter metrics and recent deploys. any deploys to `quota-mapper` or `quota-semaphore` in the last 30m?

priya: i pushed a small refill-rate tweak to `quota-semaphore` 18m ago to reduce token churn (PR #4321). not expecting this, but rolling it back now.

jon: logs show a clear pattern: tenants get assigned bucket=0 right after semaphore update. sample log: `2026-03-14T12:33:50Z quota-mapper ERROR tenant=acme-corp assigned_bucket=0 expected_bucket=100 trace=7a9b2`

sam: good catch. priya — hold rollback in prod while i try a tactical bypass for critical customers. need to avoid customer-impacting rollback churn.

priya: rolling back the semaphore change to canary and stopping further rollouts. will post the rollback command once done.

sam: mitigation plan (quick):
- enable fallback limiter for quota-service (route to legacy limiter)
- apply temporary bypass for `tier=critical` tenants
- stop quota-semaphore rollout
- open incident bridge if metrics don't recover in 10m

sam: running fallback enable now:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/limiters/quota-service/fallback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"enable":true, "reason":"PD-4872 fallback"}'
```

ops-sre: fallback toggle acknowledged. traffic shifting to fallback limiter (us-west first) — monitoring.

jon: quick query for impacted tenants:
```
select tenant_id, sum(429) as errors_last_15m from api_metrics where service='quota-service' group by tenant_id order by errors_last_15m desc limit 10;
```
returns top tenants: acme-corp (1,834 429s), beta-inc (412), partner-x (205).

marta: pinging account execs for acme-corp and beta-inc, telling them we're mitigating and will follow up. any ETA on when 429s should drop after fallback?

sam: expecting partial relief in ~60-90s after route change, full normalization if rollback or patch applied. watching grafana.

(priya): rollback applied to canary, stopping rollout to the rest. command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/quota-semaphore -n production --to-revision=4320`

sam: saw a dip in 429s around 12:36:10Z — baseline starting to return in us-west. global graphs still elevated in eu-central.

jon: found a race in quota-mapper: when semaphore refill is set to 0 briefly, mapping can produce zero-bucket assignment. patch ready (fix race + add guard): commit 7a9b2f4 — staging tested. prepping hotfix to prod.

sam: temp bypass script to exempt critical tenants:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/tenants/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenants": ["acme-corp","beta-inc"], "mode":"bypass", "expires_in":"1h"}'
```

ops-sre: bypass applied for acme-corp and beta-inc. confirming reduced 429s for those tenants. +1 on deploying the hotfix.

marta: accounting impact — will this bypass produce unexpected cost? tagging finance. also flagging customer comms draft.

sam: deploying hotfix (7a9b2f4) now to quota-mapper with canary then prod. bridge on standby.

(priya): confirm rollback complete for quota-semaphore to previous revision. no further rollouts.

jon: canary hotfix looks good, metrics stable. promoting to prod.

sam: prod hotfix applied. global 429 rate down from peak ~18k/min to ~120/min. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/limiter/overview?orgId=1&from=now-30m

marta: i just updated the customer comms: short note to acme-corp and beta-inc that we observed unexpected throttling, mitigation applied, and follow-up will include root cause and timeline.

sam: marking incident as mitigated. will keep bridge open for postmortem prep. next steps: full RCA (race in quota-mapper), revert strategy review, better pre-deploy metrics, and add automated canary rollback on assigned_bucket anomalies.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4872 status updated: Mitigated by sam at 2026-03-14T12:42:38Z. No escalation required. :white_check_mark:

sam: closing the urgent page. creating incident doc and assigning follow-up tasks in #postmortems. thanks all — great fast work. :thumbsup:
